Read the content of Build.bat to understand what arguments it expects.

- Target: `TranslatorsCardEditor` (editor target for development)

content.text: Now let me read the Build.bat file to understand the arguments it expects:

content.content:
1→@echo off
     2→
     3→rem ## Unreal Engine code build script
     4→rem ## Copyright Epic Games, Inc. All Rights Reserved.
     5→rem ##
     6→rem ## This script is expecting to exist in the /Engine/Build/BatchFiles directory.  It will not work correctly
     7→rem ## if you copy it to a different location and run it.
     8→rem ##
     9→rem ##     %1 is the game name
    10→rem ##     %2 is the platform name
    11→rem ##     %3 is the configuration name
    12→rem ##     additional args are passed directly to UnrealBuildTool
    13→
    14→setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
    15→
    16→set ExitCode=
    17→set WaitingForLock=0
    18→set LockFile=%~f0
    19→set LockFile=%LockFile:\=-%
    20→set LockFile=%tmp%\%LockFile::=%.lock
    21→
    22→call :Lock %*
    23→exit /B !ExitCode!
    24→
    25→:Lock
    26→9>&2 2>nul (call :LockAndRestoreStdErr %* 9>"%LockFile%") || (
    27→	if "!ExitCode!" NEQ "" exit /B !ExitCode!
    28→	if %WaitingForLock% == 0 set WaitingForLock=1 && echo %~nx0 is already running, waiting for existing script to terminate...
    29→	ping 127.0.0.1 -n 2 >nul
    30→	goto :Lock
    31→)
    32→exit /B !ExitCode!
    33→
    34→:LockAndRestoreStdErr
    35→call :Main %* 2>&9
    36→exit /B !ExitCode!
    37→
    38→:Main
    39→
    40→rem ## First, make sure the batch file exists in the folder we expect it to.  This is necessary in order to
    41→rem ## verify that our relative path to the /Engine/Source directory is correct
    42→if not exist "%~dp0..\..\Source" goto Error_BatchFileInWrongLocation
    43→
    44→rem ## Change the CWD to /Engine/Source.  We always need to run UnrealBuildTool from /Engine/Source!
    45→pushd "%~dp0\..\..\Source"
    46→if not exist ..\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat goto Error_BatchFileInWrongLocation
    47→
    48→set UBTPath="..\..\Engine\Binaries\DotNET\UnrealBuildTool\UnrealBuildTool.dll"
    49→
    50→rem ## Verify that dotnet is present
    51→call "%~dp0GetDotnetPath.bat"
    52→if errorlevel 1 goto Error_NoDotnetSDK
    53→REM ## Skip msbuild detection if using dotnet as this is done for us by dotnet-cli
    54→
    55→rem ## Compile UBT if the project file exists
    56→:ReadyToBuildUBT
    57→set ProjectFile="Programs\UnrealBuildTool\UnrealBuildTool.csproj"
    58→if not exist %ProjectFile% goto NoProjectFile
    59→
    60→if exist "%~dp0\BuildUBT.bat" (
    61→	call "%~dp0\BuildUBT.bat"
    62→	if errorlevel 1 goto Error_UBTCompileFailed
    63→) ELSE (
    64→	rem ## Only build if UnrealBuildTool.dll is missing if BuildUBT.bat does not exist
    65→	if not exist %UBTPath% (
    66→		echo Building UnrealBuildTool with dotnet...
    67→		dotnet build %ProjectFile% -c Development -v quiet
    68→		dotnet publish %ProjectFile% -c Development --output ..\Binaries\DotNET\UnrealBuildTool --no-build -v quiet
    69→		if errorlevel 1 goto Error_UBTCompileFailed
    70→	)
    71→)
    72→
    73→:NoProjectFile
    74→
    75→rem ## Run UBT
    76→:ReadyToBuild
    77→if not exist %UBTPath% goto Error_UBTMissing
    78→echo Running UnrealBuildTool: dotnet %UBTPath% %*
    79→dotnet %UBTPath% %*
    80→set ExitCode=!ERRORLEVEL!
    81→EXIT /B !ExitCode!
    82→
    83→:Error_BatchFileInWrongLocation
    84→echo ERROR: The batch file does not appear to be located in the Engine/Build/BatchFiles directory. This script must be run from within that directory.
    85→set ExitCode=999
    86→EXIT /B !ExitCode!
    87→
    88→:Error_NoDotnetSDK
    89→echo ERROR: Unable to find an install of Dotnet SDK.  Please make sure you have it installed and that `dotnet` is a globally available command.
    90→set ExitCode=999
    91→EXIT /B !ExitCode!
    92→
    93→:Error_UBTCompileFailed
    94→echo ERROR: Failed to build UnrealBuildTool.
    95→set ExitCode=999
    96→EXIT /B !ExitCode!
    97→
    98→:Error_UBTMissing
    99→echo ERROR: UnrealBuildTool.dll not found in %UBTPath%
   100→set ExitCode=999
   101→EXIT /B !ExitCode!
   102→
